entities.title: Universal Temporal Value (UTV)
entities.summary: A temporal data model that tells the truth about time, including when the truth is "it depends" or "nobody knows": a specification, its schema and conformance material, and libraries in five languages.
entities.purpose: Holds UTV 1.0 and everything that implements and checks it: the normative specification (spec/), the structural JSON Schema (schema/), language-neutral conformance material (conformance/), the C#, Java, Python, Rust and TypeScript libraries (implementations/), the library contracts and rationale (docs/), the repository's checks (tools/, run by .github/workflows/), and the HASD skills and knowledge catalogue copied into Meta/.
boundaries: The specification, the schema and the conformance material share one version number; each library is versioned on its own (VERSIONING.md).
No example programs: every example is a unit test in a library (AGENTS.md section 2).
Meta/ is a copy of HASD's Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge, changed there and copied here, so it has no .dev of its own.
